historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for a three-story vertical addition to an existing one-story-plus-mezzanine commercial building at 2235 Mission Street, resulting in a 50-foot-tall mixed-use building with six dwelling units over 5,522 square feet of commercial space.
An existing one-story-plus-mezzanine commercial building stood at the property.
